units: shares in millions; money in USD millions; price in USD per share; rates as decimals

price.source: NYSE close Fri 9 Oct 2026 (last close before as_of): stockanalysis.com/stocks/hubs/history/ and Yahoo Finance chart API query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/HUBS, both retrieved 2026-10-12; the two agree

shares.source: Pinned, engagement.json: 49.658M basic + 2.745M RSUs/PSUs, options out of the money (Q2 2026 10-Q; module 01)

debt.source: Pinned, engagement.json: no borrowings at 30 Jun 2026; leases excluded (Q2 2026 10-Q Note 10; module 01)

cash.source: Pinned, engagement.json: cash 958.3 + ST inv. 379.6 + LT inv. 45.3 at 30 Jun 2026 (Q2 2026 10-Q; module 01)

base_fcf_margin.definition: (OCF - capex - capitalized software - SBC) / revenue, TTM; before restructuring add-back
base_fcf_margin.source: Module 01; re-run from EDGAR XBRL: OCF 856.4 - PP&E 58.9 - cap. software 139.1 - SBC 514.7 = 143.7; / 3,449.0 = 4.17%

discount_rate.method: CAPM cost of equity; no debt so cost of equity = discount rate. 5.24% + 1.25 x 4.20% = 10.49%, rounded to 10.5%

risk_free.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve, 10-year, 9 Oct 2026 (home.treasury.gov daily-treasury-rates.csv, 2026)

beta.source: Damodaran, Betas by Sector (US), Software (System & Application), unlevered beta corrected for cash 1.25, Jan 2026 (pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/Betas.html). Cross-checks: stockanalysis.com 5Y beta 1.24 (updated 11 Oct 2026); own regression vs S&P 500 from Yahoo prices 1.18 (60 monthly) to 1.27 (104 weekly)

equity_risk_premium.source: Damodaran implied ERP for S&P 500, 1 Oct 2026 (trailing 12m, adjusted payout), pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/home.htm

terminal_growth.source: Judgment: midpoint between zero real growth (2.0% long-run PCE inflation) and the full nominal-GDP cap (4.0%); a mature software firm should not hold its share of the economy forever
terminal_growth.cap_source: FOMC Summary of Economic Projections, 16 Sep 2026, Table 1 longer-run medians: real GDP 2.0% + PCE inflation 2.0% = about 4.0% nominal (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcprojtabl20260916.htm)

Intuit.source: INTU 10-K filed 2026-09-09: OCF 8,838 - PP&E 175 - cap. internal-use software 46 - SBC 2,056 = 6,561 / revenue 21,448 ($M)

Autodesk.source: ADSK 10-K filed 2026-03-03: OCF 2,452 - capex 43 - SBC 788 = 1,621 / revenue 7,206 ($M)

headline.basis: Estimate. Constant 10% revenue CAGR = equivalent of a guidance-anchored path starting at the Q3 2026 guide (+14%) and fading straight-line to 6% in year 10 (CAGR 9.97%; that fade itself needs 15.3%). Margin read from the grid row (reverse_dcf.py).
